label: PF Backlog 496
title: PFSSOT-P13: collision-safe backlog id allocation (API-authoritative reserve blocks; offline-safe)
body:
Source: recurring id collisions (BI-PF-0455->0456, BI-PF-0458->0461) + user request. Child of EPIC
BI-PF-0360 (Backlog SSOT).

PROBLEM: `core/backlog._next_id` = max(local ids)+1 over the worktree's own items, so two concurrent sessions
compute the SAME next id and collide at merge/push.

FIX (framework-agnostic; core + api only):
- core/id_allocator.py (single writer of config/id-blocks.json): reserve contiguous id BLOCKS per
  (scope, project, session); alloc() returns the next id from the session's block. session_id() = PF_SESSION_ID
  else host+pid; the worker plane passes WORKERGRID_WORKER_ID. Default block size 100 (PF_ID_BLOCK_SIZE);
  offline multi-session base offset via PF_ID_BLOCK_BASE.
- core/backlog._next_id uses the allocator (falls back to max+1 when disabled via PF_ID_ALLOC=off).
- api/routers/backlog.py: POST /api/v1/backlog/ids:reserve (operator) - the API-first authority a session calls
  to get its block (one shared PF API coordinates all sessions).
- Register config/id-blocks.json in config/store-registry.json.
- Backstop unchanged: scripts/dev/backlog_id_audit.py (BI-PF-0457) fails the merge gate on any duplicate id.

Acceptance: two sessions reserving from the same authority get disjoint blocks; ids remain BI-<TAG>-<nnn>;
offline a session allocates within its reserved block; duplicate-id audit stays green; no opencode/dashboard ref.

links.backend_capability: module:core/id_allocator.py, module:core/backlog.py,
route:/api/v1/backlog/ids:reserve, test:test-framework/tests/pipeline/test_id_allocator.py
